features.title: Patron and familiar
features.text: Your patron determines your magical tradition and grants distinctive hexes and familiar abilities. Prepare spells through your familiar to fit the day's challenges.

features.title: A coordinated pair
features.text: Use spells, hexes and your familiar's patron ability together. Position the familiar carefully and choose when its special effects help more than another direct attack.
